node.statement: Associator transfer: write m for the original product, m'=m+Delta for bold-dot, and rho=5 epsilon_X. Expanding A'=m'(m'(x,y),z)-m'(x,m'(y,z)) gives the original associator plus m(Delta(x,y),z)-m(x,Delta(y,z))+Delta(m'(x,y),z)-Delta(x,m'(y,z)). The original bounds and ||m'(u,v)||<=(1+6 epsilon_X)||u||||v|| therefore give ||A'||<=[epsilon_X+2(1+epsilon_X)rho+2(1+6 epsilon_X)rho]||x||||y||||z||=[21 epsilon_X+70 epsilon_X^2]||x||||y||||z||<=100 epsilon_X||x||||y||||z|| for epsilon_X<=1/100. Together with node 1.3.1 this proves node 1.3.
